doc: Portfolio-to-product design language for the Quniverse. The Quniverse portfolio is DESIGN-SYSTEM-1 (_shared/design-system.js): neutrals, status colours, type and spacing scales, shape and tap size are fixed. A product (a domain plane or an app) varies only its accent hue inside hue_range_deg of the portfolio seed. _shared/design-language.mjs derives each product's accent tokens and proves every contrast pair in both themes; `node _shared/design-language.mjs --write` regenerates the css strings below and the test fails on a stale one. A worker adopts a product theme by passing its css to dsHead(title, description, extraCss). Same layers as ultrastable's doctrine/design.json, kept in each repository because the two brands are separate.

research.role: papers, the fleet dashboard, research tools

personal.role: the companion, job search, markets: calm and personal
